completeCollection.rule: Only producer metadata with complete=true, hasMore=false, and compatible returned/total counts becomes collection_completeness=COMPLETE.

truncatedCollection.rule: purchase overview returnedCount < summary.taskCount or queryReceipt.truncated/possiblyTruncated becomes PARTIAL.

emptyCompleteShortage.rule: No identified shortage can be stated only from formal READY plus a COMPLETE collection; absence of projected rows is insufficient.

unknownNumeric.rule: null, undefined, and non-finite quantities are omitted rather than projected as zero.
